name: Docker
description: Manage Docker containers, images, volumes, networks and Compose, with built-in DBX AI and MCP tools for queries and permission-controlled operations.

versions.releaseNotes: First DBX Store submission. Adds a Docker Engine connection provider and workbench with container lifecycle, container rename, image pull/push/export, image tagging and per-tag removal, image layer history, live logs, ECharts resource monitoring, read-only container file browsing with download and upload, an interactive container terminal (docker exec over a binary channel), disk usage, and a controlled Compose subset. Cleanup runs in a guarded dialog with a read-only preview and a typed confirmation, and follows Docker CLI defaults. The UI follows the DBX interface language and reuses DBX transport layers instead of building its own SSH tunnel.

Adds built-in DBX AI Agent and external MCP tools with default-off per-connection permissions; resource details and network/volume management; YAML Compose editing, compact themed tables, file menus/previews and unified transfer tasks; backend preview/confirmation gates for destructive operations. Adds Windows named pipes, optional OS-default local sockets and native Windows pipe paths. Fixes SSH nc/sudo nc MaxSessions exhaustion with shared session limits, cancellable queues, idle expiry and bounded retries before Docker requests. Requires DBX 0.6.43 or newer.
